answer: Each epoch opens a commit queue sealed as one timber whose gate every key opens by posting an escrowed hash of its reply first, revealed only after the window shuts, so no clone can read a peer text and mirror it. A reveal mismatching its hash forfeits a 400 POA bond. An ocean of keys under one funding root still files one commit per key per epoch, and two reveals sharing one entropy stamp are jointly slashed at 300 POA each. Copying buys a super-linear bond per clone while honest work keeps full weight.
